messages:
Priya Nair: Quick health check for Zenith (zenith-inc). Onboarding ~60%, customer ramped to prod traffic yesterday and we're seeing 95p gen latency jump from ~220ms -> ~480ms. They're sensitive to cost and worried about UX. Proactive proposal: quantize -> model swap -> routing to reduce p95 and unit cost. @Ethan can you validate perf delta and suggest canary plan? @Maria can you schedule an enablement + quality signoff with engineering?

Ethan Cho: On it. I'll run the benchmark harness against the exact traffic profile. Do we have an int8 profile for redwood-4-compact on A10G tested recently? If not, recommend 5% canary traffic first. Also need expected token-cost delta numbers to share with the account.

Maria Lopez: I can book a 30-min walkthrough with Zenith next Tue (their AM). I'll capture their eval prompts and set up a quick quality checklist (BLEU/ROUGE-ish + human spot-check).

Priya Nair: Proposed plan (high-level):
1) Create canary with redwood-4-compact int8 profile (5% traffic)
2) Observe perf/quality for 24h, if stable -> 25% for 12h -> full swap
3) Route Zenith to us-west dedicated pool during canary to hit lower tail latencies
4) Rollback knob: immediate traffic switch to redwood-4-xl fp16 (previous) + notify customer
Please include expected cost delta per 1M tokens in the canary ticket.

Ethan Cho: Example routing + canary snippet to use in infra config:```
route_rules:
  - match: {customer_id: "zenith-inc"}
    policy:
      primary: redwood-4-compact-int8
      fallback: redwood-4-xl-fp16
      canary: {percent: 5, evaluation_window: "24h"}
      region: us-west-2
```
I'll attach perf numbers once the harness runs.

CS Bot: [Alert] latency_spike detected for zenith-inc at 2026-02-18T14:03:12Z. p95=482ms, p50=210ms. Metrics: https://console.redwood/infr/metrics/zenith-inc/latency

Maria Lopez: Capturing acceptance criteria for the customer: p95 < 300ms or match current baseline while reducing $/1k tokens by >= 18%. I'll gather a small prompt set from them for canary.

Priya Nair: Thanks — next actions: Ethan create INF ticket + perf estimate (due EOD), Maria schedule enablement + collect prompts, I'll prep comms for the customer + renewal owner. If all green, we recommend moving them to Dedicated reserved pool (discounted commit) to lock cost predictability. :thumbsup:

Ethan Cho: Logged INF-4921 with initial bench plan. ETA EOD for numbers.

Maria Lopez: Meeting sent (invite accepted). Will post notes and the customer's eval set here once I have it.

Priya Nair: Perfect — keep this thread updated. If anyone wants to pair on the canary run, ping me.
